articles.summary: HANOI, Vietnam, Sept. 12, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- VinFast and GSM today officially announced new leadership appointments, succeeding Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong and Ms. Pham Thu Huong in senior global leadership roles. Accordingly, Mr. Pham Nhat Quan Anh, currently Chairman of VinFast Global, will concurrently assume the position of CEO of VinFast Global, succeeding Mr. Pham Nhat Vuong, while also taking on the roles of Chairman and CEO of VinFast Vietnam. articles.summary: Rome/Singapore, 16th September 2026 – SACE, the Italian Export Credit Agency owned by the Ministry of Economy and Finance has announced a USD 200 million financing facility for VinFast Vietnam JSC (“VinFast Vietnam”), a subsidiary of VinFast Auto Ltd. (“VinFast”), the electric vehicle arm of Vingroup, Vietnam’s largest private conglomerate.
articles.title: SACE announces USD 200 million financing for VinFast Vietnam, driving global cooperation in green mobility

articles.summary: Jakarta, September 16, 2026 – Green SM has officially launched its electric motorbike service in Jakarta, adding two-wheeled mobility to the all-electric transportation ecosystem the company is developing in Indonesia. With both electric taxis and electric motorbikes, Green SM in Indonesia will offer convenient, modern, fast, and accessible mobility options tailored to the everyday transportation needs of urban residents.
articles.title: GREEN SM LAUNCHES ELECTRIC MOTORBIKE SERVICE IN INDONESIA, MARKING ITS FIRST INTERNATIONAL MARKET

articles.summary: Hanoi, September 10, 2026 – Vingroup has been ranked 340th in TIME’s World’s Best Companies 2026, placing the Group among the world’s Top 400 companies. Compared with 2025, Vingroup has risen nearly 500 places and remains the only Vietnamese company to be recognized on the prestigious ranking.
articles.title: VINGROUP RISES NEARLY 500 PLACES TO RANK AMONG THE WORLD’S TOP 350 COMPANIES
